lines.text: Sennacherib king of Assyria invaded Judah, and Hezekiah saw that he had come to make war against Jerusalem.
Hezekiah consulted his leaders, and many people stopped up all the springs and the stream outside the city.
Hezekiah rebuilt the wall, produced many chariots and horses, and told the people the LORD was with them.
While besieging Damascus, Sennacherib sent servants and letters mocking the LORD, saying no god had delivered a people from him.
After Hezekiah and Isaiah prayed, the LORD sent an angel that destroyed the Assyrian leaders, and He saved Jerusalem.
